TryModifyEnergyCostInCombatLate.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-27, re-verified 2026-08-04 (line-shift only). The phase half (G2) is CLOSED: the port now overrides `modify_card_energy_cost_late` (sts2_rl/relics/brilliant_scarf.py:29-33) and HookSystem._each runs the Late pass as its own complete walk (sts2_rl/hooks.py:48, 664-681). WHAT REMAINS is guard G3: ShouldModifyCost's other two clauses (BrilliantScarf.cs:102-132) -- the card's owner must be the relic's owner, and the card must currently be in the Hand or Play pile -- are still absent; the port checks only the counter, so the relic would zero the displayed cost of a draw-, discard- or exhaust-pile card. DORMANT: no ported effect reads a non-hand card's cost on the fifth-card turn.

TryModifyStarCost.rationale: Star cost is the second, parallel cost currency (TryModifyStarCost, BrilliantScarf.cs:57-66) and the sim models no star-cost concept anywhere -- grep for 'star' over sts2_rl/ returns no cost machinery. It is not Ironclad content: no ported card carries a star cost, so there is nothing for the relic to zero. Waived as out-of-scope currency rather than as an unported hook, because the whole SYSTEM is absent from the sim's scope, not merely this relic's use of it. If star costs are ever ported, this waiver must be revisited -- the relic zeroes BOTH costs on the same fifth card.

BeforeSideTurnStart.rationale: C#'s hook is turn_structure step 9 (before the block clear); the sim's on_player_turn_start is executed-confirmed to sit at step ~19, after the block clear and the energy reset (py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order). Only a counter RESET happens here, and no card can be played between the two points -- the play phase opens at step 28 -- so CardsPlayedThisTurn is 0 at every moment either codebase can observe it. Same reasoning and same verdict as relic/beating_remnant's BeforeSideTurnStart in batch 1; recorded as a divergence rather than faithful because the slot genuinely differs and a future effect placed in that window would expose it.

AfterCombatEnd.maps_to: no counterpart; on_player_turn_start (brilliant_scarf.py:37-38) is the only reset
AfterCombatEnd.rationale: BrilliantScarf.cs:96-100 zeroes CardsPlayedThisTurn at combat end as well as at turn start. The sim keeps only the turn-start half, and the stale value is provably unreadable: the first player turn of the next combat runs on_player_turn_start before the play phase opens, so the counter is 0 before any card can be played or any cost modified. The pool-wide scan (py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-reset) classifies this relic in the 'reset at a TURN boundary only' bucket, which is the relic/art_of_war shape -- safe, but only because the turn reset runs before any reader, which is the trace PROMPT.md bug class 13 requires and which is done here. Contrast relic/belt_buckle, where the analogous missing reset is live.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): C#'s AfterCardPlayed skips auto-plays (`if (cardPlay.IsAutoPlay) return;`, BrilliantScarf.cs:84-87); the sim's on_card_played counts every play
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27, re-verified 2026-08-04 (line-shift only): auto-plays are excluded. `HookSystem.on_card_played` carries an `is_auto_play` argument that CombatState._resolve_card_play passes through (sts2_rl/combat.py:1208-1209), and sts2_rl/relics/brilliant_scarf.py:35-42 opens `if is_auto_play: return` -- BrilliantScarf.cs:84-87's `if (cardPlay.IsAutoPlay) return;`. The comment there also pins PROMPT.md class 29: rainbow_ring and razor_tooth deliberately DO count auto-plays and must not copy this. WAS: the counter incremented unconditionally, so every auto-play shifted which card got the free cost for the rest of the turn.

guards.what: G2 (DORMANT): the hook is TryModifyEnergyCostInCombat**Late** and the sim's modify_card_energy_cost is a single flat pass with no phase structure
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27, re-verified 2026-08-04 (line-shift only): the relic sits on the LATE pass. sts2_rl/relics/brilliant_scarf.py:29-33 overrides `modify_card_energy_cost_late` (BrilliantScarf.cs:57's TryModifyEnergyCostInCombatLate), and HookSystem._each runs the phase passes -- very_early, early, plain, late -- as COMPLETE separate listener walks whenever any listener declares a variant (sts2_rl/hooks.py:48, 664-681). Running last is what guarantees the 0 is final rather than re-raised by a plain-phase listener. WAS: the port implemented the plain `modify_card_energy_cost` and the sim had no phase structure at all.

guards.what: G3 (DORMANT): the sim's modify_card_energy_cost drops ShouldModifyCost's owner check and its Hand/Play pile check (BrilliantScarf.cs:102-132)
guards.issue: C# refuses to modify a cost unless the card's owner is the relic's owner AND the card is currently in the Hand or Play pile; brilliant_scarf.py:29-32 checks only the counter. The pile clause is the substantive one: it stops the relic zeroing the displayed cost of a card sitting in the draw, discard or exhaust pile, which the game queries when PREVIEWING costs. REACHABILITY (DORMANT): the sim's cost hook is consulted from previews.py and cards/base.py, and its preview call sites pass hand cards; no ported effect asks for the cost of a draw- or discard-pile card while Brilliant Scarf is on its fifth-card turn. Porting a relic or card that reads or pays a non-hand card's cost -- a 'play the top card of your draw pile' effect is the obvious shape, and powers.py:4498 (re-verified 2026-08-04; was :3583, moved) already auto-plays from the draw pile -- makes it live. Note the C# clause admits PileType.Play as well as Hand, which is the pile-limbo subtlety PROMPT.md bug class 7 records: a card mid-OnPlay is in Play, and the relic must still see it.
